### Risks

- Instructions could imply that copying the template authorizes installation or initialization.
- Examples could accidentally target the template root.

### Acceptance criteria

- The relative README link resolves and the guide explicitly states that the template is not initialized.
- The guide directs an agent to specialize a real copied project, obtain separate authority, use the immutable wheel, and run one direct init-memory command with no preview step.
- The guide explains expected project-local outputs and safe failure behavior without containing credentials.
- The manual guide uses the shared preparation/asset/registry helpers to specialize identity, refresh exactly the six baseline packages and SOUL.md from reviewed depot sources, record factual inventory, install the exact wheel and protections, then invoke init-memory once. It does not assume template-embedded skills equal current depot versions.
- Shared preparation supports a manually copied, project-owned destination without recopying its tree or overwriting unrelated files; memory initialization logic is not duplicated.

### Planned verification

- Resolve every local link.
- Compare commands with the installed Memory Service entry point.
- Search for preview instructions and any command targeting the template root.
